selection: Every originally admitted opportunity-policy record from frozen50; reject records remain excluded, no selection by results
pair: Same frozen state WITH target pending versus WITHOUT only target pending; no cash refund, no new signals
first_hour: Seed historical closed5m prefix known at decision; never manufacture a complete confirmation hour
terminal: Costed mark of remaining positions, not successful realized exit
risk_metric: Booked estimated entry risk/current costed NAV, not realized loss or remaining stop risk
sample_dependence: Repeated policies/opportunities and overlapping histories are dependent; no pooled calibrated probability
